scope: Pre-admission source screening only; no candidate in this registry is a model target.

screened_candidates.candidate_rationale: The project exposes 20 clearly named NP01?NP04 runs and a 137,662-byte author-result archive containing four spreadsheets, so it was screened as a possible source-level covariate-map supplement.
screened_candidates.species_evidence: All inspected Protein worksheets contain source protein headers with OS=Bos taurus, including APOA1_BOVIN, HBA_BOVIN, HBBF_BOVIN, ALBU_BOVIN and SERPINC1_BOVIN.
screened_candidates.reason: A bovine protein-corona study cannot be silently substituted for the pre-frozen human-biofluid cohort or described as cross-species validation.
